description:
Configure a new 'staging' build type for the Unscramble Android app. The project is already open in Android Studio.

Open the module-level build file (app/build.gradle.kts) and add a new build type named 'staging' inside the buildTypes block. Configure it with the following requirements:

1. It must inherit from the 'debug' build type (use initWith)
2. It must have an applicationIdSuffix of ".staging"
3. It must have a versionNameSuffix of "-STAGING"
4. It must define a String BuildConfig field named "BASE_URL" with the value "https://staging.api.unscramble.com"

After configuring the build script, sync the project and build the new variant to verify it works (e.g., using ./gradlew assembleStaging or the Build Variants panel).
